sessions.reply:


The task said "under $600", so I used 600 as the limit. If you want a strict "under", change it to 599.

sessions.name: B
sessions.reply:
I created `groceries.csv` with an item and cost for each line, and `meal-plan.md` with a budget summary for December 2026. The list totals $583, which leaves $17 of room under your $600 limit.

My first draft came to $648, over the limit. I took out household staples ($40), since paper goods and cleaning supplies aren't groceries, and a $25 price-change buffer. If you want either back, you'd need to cut about the same amount from the food lines.

`meal-plan.md` also has a table of costs by category and some meal ideas. I checked that the category totals add up to $583.

The $17 of headroom is your flag threshold. Adding anything over $17 to the list takes the month past $600.
